about: Step 3: the extra cue design -> cues_extra.json (owned by the sound build; the builders' S*.cues.json stay untouched).

conventions.frame: absolute film frame at 30 fps; sample = frame * 1600
conventions.anchor: default = each palette file's own anchor (onset for hits and clicks, peak for whooshes and pass-bys, end for risers); 'start' = the file's first sample sits on the frame
conventions.pan: -1 left .. +1 right; pan_to makes it a sweep across the sound
conventions.builder whooshes: a builder whoosh cue marks the START of the whip; the whoosh starts there and peaks on the picture's transition peak (found within +3..+12 frames), i.e. 6-10 frames later
conventions.builder risers: start on the cue and end exactly on the next hero cue (impact / sting / crate / swell within 200 frames)
